nodes.label: improve-review-from-pr-gap SKILL.md
nodes.rationale: Treating a fix-PR oversight as a one-off incident wastes the lesson; converting it into a reusable ./.review/ perspective means future PRs with the same shape of problem get caught before merge. Only gaps detectable from the original diff at review time are converted into perspectives — issues only visible at runtime are recorded in the report but not turned into a check, since a perspective describing something no reviewer could apply by reading a diff is not a check, it's a wish.

nodes.label: improve-review-from-session SKILL.md
nodes.rationale: Must be performed inline by the main agent, never delegated to a subagent: the source material is the live conversation history (corrections, near-misses) that a freshly spawned subagent would not have, so it could only fabricate generic-sounding advice. The value of the whole ./.review/ system compounds only if this extraction actually happens after sessions that taught the project something.

nodes.label: review-pr SKILL.md
nodes.rationale: Each review dimension is run as its own subagent because a single reviewer trying to hold many different lenses in mind at once tends to blur them together and miss things a dedicated pass would catch; every subagent must report in one shared FINDING format so Phase 4 deduplication can be done mechanically rather than by re-reading prose.

nodes.label: review-uncommitted SKILL.md
nodes.rationale: Reviews run concurrently across dimensions and custom perspectives so wall-clock cost stays low as the number of perspectives grows; the skill stays strictly read-only because conflating review and fixing tends to produce hasty patches and hides the tradeoffs the user should weigh.

nodes.label: Domain と Table 境界の非1:1原則
nodes.norm_label: domain と table 境界の非1:1原則
nodes.rationale: DDDの集約境界は「整合性を守る単位」、テーブル境界は「正規化とJOIN戦略の単位」であり、両者は独立した設計判断。CLIが `gluon g domain` 実行時にmigrationも自動生成すると『domain = table』という誤解を植え付けるため、意図的にmigration生成を分離し、`gluon g migration`を明示的に呼ばせてRepository実装側で複数テーブルから1 aggregateを組み立てる責務をユーザーに残している。

view

テンフレートハス非公開の原則
nodes.rationale: 任意ファイル読み込み(path traversal)を防ぐセキュリティ上の理由により、`View::with_template_path` のようなテンプレートパスを直接指定できる公開APIを意図的に提供していない。テンプレートパスはgluon-buildが生成するhandler wrapperがCURRENT_TEMPLATE task-localで同階層page.tsxの絶対パスを注入する仕組みに限定される。

nodes.label: gluon-cli references/validation.md
nodes.rationale: CLI入力(route / identifier / field type)を厳格に検証するのは、(1)任意ファイル書き込み(例: '../../etc/passwd')、(2)生成されるRustソースへの任意コード注入、(3)生成されるSQLへの注入、の3つを防ぐため。検証NGの場合は最初にexit code 1で失敗し、部分的にファイルを生成した状態で止まることはない。
